job_description: Executive - Planning, Monitoring & Control (Textile Division), Gazipur : Epyllion Group Jobs ENG বাংলা Create Account Sign In For Employer Create Sign In Home Jobs Mybdjobs Job List Epyllion Group Executive - Planning, Monitoring & Control (Textile Division), Gazipur Application Deadline : 30 Mar 2026 Apply Now Shortlist Share: Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp All Requirements Responsibilities Skills & Expertise Salary & Benefits Company Information Summary Vacancy: 1 Age: At least 26 years Location: Gazipur Salary: Negotiable Published: 28 Feb 2026 Application Insights View Requirements Education Experience Additional Requirements Age At least 26 years Good communication (written/verbal) & presentation skills. Strong analytical & leadership ability and work as a strategic thinker. Self-driven to work under pressure and self-motivated to take new initiatives. Ability to maintain good interpersonal relationships and good team work. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Responsibilities & Context Receive and verify booking information from PMC via ERP, ensuring all required details are accurate and complete. Cross-check development/SP bookings with R&D and Lab to confirm approvals, submission status, and comments before production. Coordinate PP meetings with merchants and production teams to identify risks and ensure smooth execution. Monitor yarn in-house status with Supply Chain and align material availability with T&A to avoid delays. Prepare and circulate monthly fabric delivery, knitting, and dyeing plans; track weekly OTT performance. Develop batch plans for dyeing and finishing to ensure efficient production flow and capacity utilization. Coordinate with all departments to resolve production issues quickly and support necessary commercial decisions. Ensure on-time throughput (OTT) and on-time delivery (OTD) by closely monitoring knitting, dyeing, and finishing progress. Optimize resource utilization by managing yarn and fabric stock, reducing wastage, analyzing process loss, and supporting profitability improvement. Skills & Expertise Capacity Planning Production Planning Planning and monitoring Process optimization Reporting Compensation & Other Benefits Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Insurance,Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Gazipur Company Information Epyllion Group Follow More jobs from this company Address: Corporate Office: NINAKABBO, Level: 12, 227/A, Tejgaon-Gulshan Link Road, Postal Code: 1208, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
